public_definitions: The goal is to review the browser usage-share dashboard and assign additional support capacity to the browser with the highest current market_share.
The comparison scope is the market_share values shown in the bar chart.
The rule is to select the browser with the highest current market_share.
The business reason is that the highest-usage browser has the largest support load and user-impact surface.
